The `sort_keys` (date created/modified) are already computed server-side and embedded in the card HTML (`data-sort-dateCreated`, `data-sort-dateModified`), so the only changes needed are:
- Change the dropdown default from `'Default Sort'` to a date-based sort (`'Date Modified'`).
- Make the JavaScript apply the sort on initial load so the new default takes effect.

These two files are the ones that need modification.
